summary: This course provides an opportunity for HDR students to apply and develop professional skills and attributes in an area of their choice.
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must be enrolled in a PhD or MPhil program offered by the College of Engineering, Computing and Cybernetics and meet the eligibility criteria for internship placements, which include an agreement with the host institution that has also been approved by the relevant College Authorities.
